description.text: Main Courses Scientific management, Introduction of city, City planning principle, Introduction of modern city, Landscape architecture, Introduction, Urban management regulations, City land utilization and management, Urban environmental management, Urban ecology, Urban economics, Urban planning and management, Urban geography, Urban community construction and management, Project management, Urban road and traffic management, Management of urban utilities, Gardens and virescence management, Management of city appearance and sanitation, Population and social security management, Property management.

duration.text: The Urban Management at Soochow University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3-6 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required
